title: Canonical relative comparison triangles on an arbitrary compact source-open union
statement: Let f:X→S, f′:X′→S′, g:S′→S and g′:X′→X be a cartesian square of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with S,S′ affine and f quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Let K and K′ have quasi-coherent derived cohomology [def-pc-derived-category], and let φ:L(g′)*K→K′ [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Let U,V⊆X be compact opens whose intersection is compact. Write a_Z for the arrow b_Z given by the canonical open comparison [def-pc-single-complex-open-comparison]. There exist distinguished triangles in D(O_S′) with vertices (domain a_(U∪V), domain a_U direct-sum domain a_V, domain a_(U∩V)) and respectively (codomain a_(U∪V), codomain a_U direct-sum codomain a_V, codomain a_(U∩V)), and a morphism between them whose three components are exactly a_(U∪V), the biproduct of a_U and a_V, and a_(U∩V). No comparison is assumed or asserted invertible, and U∪V need not be all of X.

source.place: Tag 0DJ9, induction diagram applied inside U union V; Tags 08HZ and 08HY. Verified from the online Stacks pages on 2026-10-14.

proof.text: Obtain the short exact complex presentation P,P′,m and six vertex comparisons on U∪V. This is the geometric construction before passage to triangles.

Define the first two maps by conjugating Q(P.f), Q(P.g) and their primed analogues by the vertex isomorphisms. Define the boundaries by conjugating triangleOfSESδ with the overlap comparison and shifted union comparison. Triangle.isoMk gives isomorphisms with the Mathlib short exact triangles; isomorphic_distinguished proves both transported triangles distinguished. Conjugate triangleOfSES.map hP hP′ m by those triangle isomorphisms. Its three components simplify using the three localized-component conjugacy equations and iso inverse-hom cancellation. This gives exactly b_(U∪V), biprod.map b_U b_V, and b_(U∩V), including the connecting square from Mathlib SES naturality.

proof_origin.place: R2: geometric presentation split off; actual SES triangle construction, distinguishedness transport and triangle morphism conjugation proved in Lean.

lean.statement:
theorem singleComplexOpenComparison_union_triangles
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) [IsAffine S] [IsAffine S']
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hK : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X K)
    (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X') (hK' : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X' K')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K')
    (U V : X.Opens)
    (hUqc : IsCompact (U : Set X)) (hVqc : IsCompact (V : Set X))
    (hUVqc : IsCompact ((U ⊓ V : X.Opens) : Set X)) :
    let a : X.Opens → Arrow (schemeDerivedCategory S') := fun Z ↦
      Arrow.mk (singleComplexOpenComparison f f' g g' sq.w K K' φ Z)
    ∃ (d₁ : (a (U ⊔ V)).left ⟶ (a U).left ⊞ (a V).left)
      (d₂ : (a U).left ⊞ (a V).left ⟶ (a (U ⊓ V)).left)
      (d₃ : (a (U ⊓ V)).left ⟶ (a (U ⊔ V)).left⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
      (d₁' : (a (U ⊔ V)).right ⟶ (a U).right ⊞ (a V).right)
      (d₂' : (a U).right ⊞ (a V).right ⟶ (a (U ⊓ V)).right)
      (d₃' : (a (U ⊓ V)).right ⟶ (a (U ⊔ V)).right⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
      Triangle.mk d₁ d₂ d₃ ∈ distTriang (schemeDerivedCategory S') ∧
      Triangle.mk d₁' d₂' d₃' ∈ distTriang (schemeDerivedCategory S') ∧
      ∃ t : Triangle.mk d₁ d₂ d₃ ⟶ Triangle.mk d₁' d₂' d₃',
        t.hom₁ = (a (U ⊔ V)).hom ∧
        t.hom₂ = biprod.map (a U).hom (a V).hom ∧
        t.hom₃ = (a (U ⊓ V)).hom
